subject: CISC kickoff — cheaper self-consistency for reasoning endpoints
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Kicking off CISC productization. Background: self-consistency decoding is our largest serving-cost line on the reasoning endpoints — we sample many long paths and majority-vote. Our CISC work (Confidence-Informed Self-Consistency, the ACL Findings paper) showed a confidence-weighted majority vote reduces required reasoning paths by over 40% on average across nine models and four datasets, at equal or better accuracy.

40% off that serving line is a real number Finance will notice, which is the pitch.

Milestones (Feb 23 – Jun 8): reproduce paper results on our production models by end of March; offline A/B on logged traffic in April; serving integration + shadow deployment in May; launch review early June.

Deshawn, staffing plan when you can. The serving integration is the long pole so let's get that owner named early.

Priya
